approvalTitle: 批准自定义定时任务实施清单
content:
# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. 实现任务领域模型与规则测试
  - Files: `src/scheduled-tasks.ts`, `test/scheduled-tasks.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再定义一次性、每日、固定间隔任务模型、输入校验、Asia/Shanghai 下次运行计算与补跑上限的纯函数。
  - _Leverage: `src/trading-calendar.ts`, `test/agent-scheduler.test.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1-1.3, 2.4, NFR Performance, NFR Reliability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: TypeScript domain engineer | Task: Write failing Bun tests and implement the pure scheduled task model, validation, and deterministic Shanghai-time next-run calculation for once, daily weekdays and interval rules | Restrictions: Do not add timers, file I/O, Agent calls, or duplicate timezone logic; keep each source file under 250 non-blank lines | _Leverage: src/trading-calendar.ts, test/agent-scheduler.test.ts | _Requirements: 1.1-1.3, 2.4, NFR Performance, NFR Reliability | Success: Invalid inputs preserve caller state, all three schedule modes compute one next run, and deterministic tests cover time boundaries and catch-up cap | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 2. 实现任务状态存储及恢复测试
  - Files: `src/scheduled-task-store.ts`, `test/scheduled-task-store.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再实现版本化 JSON 原子存储、缺失文件空恢复和损坏/不兼容文件诊断。
  - _Leverage: `src/json-file.ts`, `src/paper-account-store.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.4-1.5, 5.4, NFR Security, NFR Reliability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: local persistence engineer | Task: Write failing Bun tests and implement a versioned scheduled-task JSON store with atomic saves, empty missing-file recovery, and non-destructive corrupted or incompatible-file diagnostics | Restrictions: Do not modify paper-account storage, never overwrite a corrupt source merely while loading, and keep I/O isolated from scheduling logic | _Leverage: src/json-file.ts, src/paper-account-store.ts | _Requirements: 1.1, 1.4-1.5, 5.4, NFR Security, NFR Reliability | Success: State round-trips, missing data is harmless, malformed/version-incompatible data produces a visible diagnostic without crashing | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 3. 实现任务服务及状态转换测试
  - Files: `src/scheduled-task-service.ts`, `test/scheduled-task-service.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再实现用户任务 CRUD、来源记录、暂停/恢复/删除、手动队列、到期 tick、持久化和摘要。
  - _Leverage: `src/scheduled-tasks.ts`, `src/scheduled-task-store.ts`, `src/agent-scheduler.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6, 4.5, 5.3-5.4, NFR Reliability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: scheduler service engineer | Task: Write failing Bun tests and implement ScheduledTaskService as the sole CRUD, persistence, due-event, dedupe-result, source-audit, and summary authority for user tasks | Restrictions: Do not create timers, do not call AgentController or execute trades, persist before enqueue, and share one validation path for every mutation | _Leverage: src/scheduled-tasks.ts, src/scheduled-task-store.ts, src/agent-scheduler.ts | _Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6, 4.5, 5.3-5.4, NFR Reliability | Success: CRUD is atomic, due tasks submit evidence-rich custom events once, pause/delete prevent future events, runNow preserves schedule, and summaries expose count/next/last/diagnostic | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 4. 将用户任务接入统一调度器
  - Files: `src/agent-scheduler.ts`, `test/agent-scheduler.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再向现有单一 tick 注入任务服务；维持内置任务、全局开关、手动触发和 timer 清理语义。
  - _Leverage: `src/scheduled-task-service.ts`, `src/agent-event-dispatcher.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 2.1-2.6, 5.1-5.2, NFR Performance, NFR Reliability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: TypeScript scheduler runtime engineer | Task: Add an optional scheduled-task service to AgentTaskScheduler and invoke it from the existing single tick while retaining exact preopen, intraday, dream, runNow, enabled-switch, and stop behavior | Restrictions: Do not introduce per-task timers, do not change existing public task behavior, and do not make constructor start timers | _Leverage: src/scheduled-task-service.ts, src/agent-event-dispatcher.ts | _Requirements: 2.1-2.6, 5.1-5.2, NFR Performance, NFR Reliability | Success: New failing tests demonstrate custom task ticking and global disable; existing scheduler tests remain green and stop removes the only timer | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 5. 添加 `/task` 命令与命令测试
  - Files: `src/task-commands.ts`, `src/commands.ts`, `test/commands.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再实现列表、三种新增、更新、暂停、恢复、删除、立即运行和内置任务只读说明；使用 `::` 分隔多词名称与提示。
  - _Leverage: `src/automation-commands.ts`, `src/commands.ts`, `src/command-context.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 3.1-3.5, 5.1, NFR Usability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: terminal command engineer | Task: Write failing Bun tests and add /task command adapters for list, add, update, pause, resume, remove, run and builtin using a :: separator so Chinese multiword names and prompts round-trip | Restrictions: Return Chinese errors and precise usages, never operate on built-in tasks, do not duplicate service validation, and preserve all existing command behavior | _Leverage: src/automation-commands.ts, src/commands.ts, src/command-context.ts | _Requirements: 3.1-3.5, 5.1, NFR Usability | Success: All command actions call the same task service, invalid input leaves state unchanged, and command catalog/help includes /task | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 6. 添加 Agent 定时任务管理工具
  - Files: `src/task-agent-tools.ts`, `src/agent-tools.ts`, `test/agent-tools.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再实现 Zod 校验的 `manage_scheduled_task`，并由工具返回实际的结构化服务结果。
  - _Leverage: `src/condition-agent-tools.ts`, `src/memory-agent-tools.ts`, `src/command-context.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 4.1-4.5, 1.3, 2.2, NFR Security_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Agent tool engineer | Task: Write failing Bun tests and add a write-approved, Zod-validated manage_scheduled_task tool for list/create/update/pause/resume/remove/run, returning real ScheduledTaskService results | Restrictions: Do not let the Agent alter built-ins, bypass validation, execute code/trades, or claim success without a service result; keep aggregation file below the project line cap | _Leverage: src/condition-agent-tools.ts, src/memory-agent-tools.ts, src/command-context.ts | _Requirements: 4.1-4.5, 1.3, 2.2, NFR Security | Success: Tool schemas reject malformed schedules, successful mutations retain agent source, and every action returns current structured task data | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 7. 组合任务服务并渲染状态摘要
  - Files: `src/app.ts`, `src/command-context.ts`, `src/components/agent.ts`, `test/agent.test.ts`
  - 先写失败测试，再创建/注入服务、接入调度器和上下文，并在 Agent 面板以适配宽度的一行展示自定义任务摘要。
  - _Leverage: `src/app.ts`, `src/components/agent.ts`, `src/width.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 4.4, 5.2-5.4, NFR Usability, NFR Code Architecture_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: TUI integration engineer | Task: Write failing tests and compose ScheduledTaskStore/Service into MarketIntelligenceApp, expose it through CommandContext, inject it into the scheduler, and show a compact Chinese custom-task summary in AgentWorkspace | Restrictions: Keep app.ts and agent.ts under 250 non-blank lines, use fitLine for every added visible line, add no workspace, and do not start timers in constructors | _Leverage: src/app.ts, src/components/agent.ts, src/width.ts | _Requirements: 3.1, 4.4, 5.2-5.4, NFR Usability, NFR Code Architecture | Success: Commands and tools reach the live service, app shutdown keeps existing timer/dispatcher cleanup, and narrow rendering never exceeds width | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.

- [ ] 8. 验证自定义与内置任务端到端流程
  - Files: `test/custom-scheduled-tasks-e2e.test.ts`
  - 使用 fake timer、固定时钟、临时文件和 scripted Agent 验证创建、到期派发、重启恢复、休眠补跑上限、暂停/删除、全局关闭和内置任务兼容。
  - _Leverage: `test/agent-scheduler.test.ts`, `test/main.test.ts`, `test/agent-event-dispatcher.test.ts`_
  - _Requirements: All_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec custom-scheduled-tasks, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: end-to-end QA engineer | Task: Add a deterministic Bun end-to-end test covering user-created task lifecycle, event dispatch, persistence recovery, catch-up limit, pause/remove behavior, global automation disable, and coexistence with built-in schedules | Restrictions: Do not use wall-clock waits, network calls, or source-text assertions; test observable contracts through fake clock/timer and real services | _Leverage: test/agent-scheduler.test.ts, test/main.test.ts, test/agent-event-dispatcher.test.ts | _Requirements: All | Success: The test proves custom events use the shared dispatcher without breaking preopen/intraday/dream semantics and passes repeatedly | Before code, change this task to [-] in tasks.md; after tests pass, call log-implementation with complete artifacts, then change this task to [x] in tasks.md.
